intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in the Chandigarh region, and both appear in the NIRF 2025 Engineering list. This page compares recorded fees, placements and ranks from our database and official ranking pages opened in {{year}}.

Chandigarh University vs Chitkara University is a comparison of two large private universities. CU has the higher NIRF 2025 Engineering rank on this page. Chitkara has the cleaner recorded 2023 average package.

sections.heading: Chandigarh University vs Chitkara University for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Chandigarh University if the NIRF 2025 Engineering rank matters most to you. CU is ranked 31 in that list, against Chitkara University at 89.
Choose Chitkara University if you want a recorded 2023 average package on this page. Our CU 2023 row lists a highest package of ₹55 lakh but does not have a usable average figure.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Chandigarh University's recorded B.Tech tuition on this page varies by programme, from about ₹2.16 lakh to ₹2.92 lakh a year. There is no single Total Fees programme-total row in our records, so treat these as year tuition figures.

Chitkara University has a recorded year-wise total of ₹2.10 lakh on one programme and tuition figures around ₹2.40 lakh to ₹2.54 lakh a year on others. Confirm the official fee circular for the branch and batch you will join, because private university fees change often.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Chitkara University's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹9 lakh and a highest package of ₹55 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

Chandigarh University's 2023 row on this page shows a highest package of ₹55 lakh, but the average is recorded as zero, so we do not quote an average for CU. Ask the university for its latest official placement report.
The highest figures match at ₹55 lakh in our 2023 records. The averages do not, because one side is missing a usable average.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Both universities list JEE Main on this page. Chandigarh University also runs CUCET for many programmes. Chitkara has its own admission process alongside JEE Main.
Eligibility still starts with Class 12 PCM for B.Tech. Read the current official admissions page of each university for cut-offs, entrance tests and lateral-entry rules.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are in the Chandigarh region rather than inside Sector-17 Chandigarh itself. Chandigarh University's main campus is at Gharuan, Mohali district. Chitkara University's Punjab campus is at Rajpura.
If you want the city-side convenience of Chandigarh, visit both campuses and check the daily commute, hostel and industry connections, not just the university name.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If NIRF 2025 Engineering rank is your first filter, Chandigarh University at 31 stands above Chitkara University at 89.
If you want a recorded 2023 average package on this page, Chitkara University is the clearer record, at ₹9 lakh, because CU's average is not usable here.
Fees are in a similar private-university band on both sides. Confirm the official notice for your branch before you treat either recorded year figure as a budget.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Chandigarh University or Chitkara University, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: CU has the higher NIRF 2025 Engineering rank, at 31 against Chitkara's 89. Chitkara has a recorded 2023 average of ₹9 lakh on this page. CU's 2023 highest is ₹55 lakh, but we do not have a usable average for CU here.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Tech fees for Chandigarh University vs Chitkara University?
faqs.answer: Our records show CU tuition from about ₹2.16 lakh to ₹2.92 lakh a year, depending on the programme. Chitkara has a recorded year-wise total of ₹2.10 lakh on one programme and tuition around ₹2.40 lakh to ₹2.54 lakh on others. Confirm the official circular.

faqs.question: Do both universities accept JEE Main?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both list JEE Main on this page. Chandigarh University also uses CUCET for many programmes. Check each official admissions page for the tests that apply to your branch.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for CU and Chitkara University?
faqs.answer: Chitkara's recorded 2023 average is ₹9 lakh and the highest is ₹55 lakh. CU's 2023 highest is also ₹55 lakh, but the average is not usable in our records. These are historical figures, not a guarantee.

faqs.question: Are Chandigarh University and Chitkara University in Chandigarh city?
faqs.answer: They are in the Chandigarh region, not in the city centre. CU's main campus is at Gharuan, Mohali district. Chitkara's Punjab campus is at Rajpura. Visit both if commute matters.
